prompt: The man from the NGO came again last month with seeds in a packet with English writing on it and a paper showing yields from a trial in a place I have never heard of. The seed he is offering costs more than I have and if it fails I have less than nothing and he will go back to his office in Lilongwe. What is a question I can ask him about the seed trials that will tell me if they were done on soil like mine or on soil like somewhere else?
